snippet.title: Dyrocraft 2: Reborn Multiplayer Update Trailer (0.0.2)
snippet.description:
Dive into the world of Dyrocraft 2: Reborn  and experience the adventure together with your friends! Build your own base, create farms, and fight for survival in an open sandbox world.

But beware: zombies lurk everywhere, not only dropping valuable equipment but also being able to attack you and your friends at any time. Work together, defend yourselves, and grow stronger while you continually expand your world.

Build  
Farm  
Fight  
Play together

Will you survive? ...
